item.title: Professional Hosepipe Solutions and Company Contact Information
item.description:
Expertise in Garden Hose Manufacturing and Contact Details
#

HUNG TA Garden Hose stands as a dedicated hosepipe manufacturer located in Taiwan, offering a comprehensive range of lightweight and durable next-generation expandable garden hoses and related accessories. Selecting the appropriate garden hose for your specific needs is essential for maintaining healthy lawns and gardens. Our product portfolio is designed to meet a variety of requirements, ensuring quality and reliability for both residential and professional use.

item.title: Comprehensive Solutions for Modern Gardening Needs
item.description:
Comprehensive Solutions for Modern Gardening Needs
#

Hung Ta Garden Enterprise, established in 2007, is dedicated to providing high-quality gardening tools and accessories to customers worldwide. With an annual production exceeding 1,000,000 garden hoses, we have become a trusted manufacturer and supplier for both standard and custom garden solutions.
